items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out mid-game with concussion after evaluation for head injury.
items.why: Concussion sustained vs Chiefs; first documented.
items.implication: Chargers WR1 out rest of game + protocol; bye Week 7 helps recovery timeline.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive after GTD/pregame workout; Browns left with only Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (just signed off Vikings PS).
items.why: Ankle; limited Friday, failed pregame test per Schefter/Rapoport corroboration.
items.implication: Avoid Browns RBs; thin ineffective committee.
items.opportunity: McLaughlin/Estime volume if forced, but low efficiency.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive (groin, Friday addition); Tyjae Spears active opposite.
items.why: Groin injury from Friday practice; first career miss.
items.implication: Colts TE targets redistribute to Downs/Allen/Alie-Cox; Spears gets work but limited.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs/Keenan Allen target bump; Spears handcuff/stream spot.

items.text: Weekend summary goldstandard: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/etc; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue. Projections updated.
items.implication: Core status tracking for lineup locks.
items.opportunity: Blue activation PHI depth; reverse beneficiaries on expected INs.

items.text: Eagles place QB Jalen Hurts on IR after blood clot consultations; out indefinitely (min 4 games).
items.why: Superficial blood clot in calf from cleat; multiple doctor consults.
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts; Eagles offense downgraded long-term.

items.text: Watching late: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion), Dalton Kincaid (ribs returned), Romeo Doubs (shoulder), Rashod Bateman (shoulder), Darnell Mooney (neck).
Bills WR DJ Moore inactive; Josh Palmer active.
items.why: Shoulder; aggravated prior, limited practice return.

items.text: Actives include Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara (among others expected).
items.why: Williams full practice/return; Olave/Kamara illness but practiced/trending.
items.implication: Bears offense full; Saints lead options back.
items.opportunity: Williams QB stream/start; Olave WR1; Kamara RB2/flex.

items.text: Patriots AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson both officially active; likely to play as expected with Brown returning.
items.why: Ankle issues; sources said likely, confirmed active; NE near full health.
items.implication: Brown resumes WR1 role (possible pitch count); Henderson shares with Stevenson.
items.opportunity: AJ Brown upgrade WR2/flex; Henderson RB flex if volume.

items.text: Cam Skattebo YOE 37th/43 qualifying RBs + 4 fumbles (1 lost); Giants expect Najee Harris larger role with Skattebo downgraded but still mixed; all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles driving change per sources.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris role expansion vs NO.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play (hamstring); confirmed OUT Monday.
items.implication: SF WR depth thinned vs WAS; Cooks/others routes.
items.opportunity: Brandin Cooks or remaining SF pass-catchers.

items.text: Still starting Cam Skattebo for explosiveness/TD chance esp vs NO but riskier flex (RB28 ranks) post-rotation news; was preseason hate; prefers him over Najee if forced but split likely.
items.why: Explosiveness gives best score chance despite downgrade/fumbles.
items.conflict: Usage data shows poor YOE/fumbles conflicting pure start lean.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and leaky run D.
items.why: Volume elite lately + ARI run defense soft.

items.text: Loves Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8) for volume and goal-line role vs leaky run D.
items.why: Volume + goal-line work; GB leaking vs run.
